title: [Subcontracting] Refactor event subscriber for planning components and add test for Vendor-supplied components
summary: The subcontracting planning logic was refactored to use a new event subscriber that prevents vendor-supplied components from generating separate planning demand while keeping them visible in the planning worksheet. A test was added to verify this behavior.
key_points: Event subscriber changed from OnTransferBOMOnBeforeUpdatePlanningComp to OnAfterFilterLinesWithItemToPlan
Vendor-supplied components are filtered out during planning to prevent duplicate demand generation
Vendor-supplied components remain in the planning worksheet for consumption tracking
New test verifies that vendor-supplied components are not planned separately but can be replanned if supply method changes
Refactoring improves code organization by moving logic to a more appropriate event hook
